title: Engine configuration
description: Static configuration of the engine. Defaults are placeholders; the calibrated values are in DEFAULTS of the engine.

priorVariance.description: sigma_delta^2: prior variance of the DIFFERENCES between the 6 dimensions (the preferences). Used when priorCovariance is absent: Sigma0 = sigma_delta^2 * P + sigma_c^2 * Q, with P = I - 11'/6 and Q = 11'/6.

levelPriorVariance.description: sigma_c^2: prior variance of the LEVEL (mean of the 6 dimensions, i.e. the intercept of the reward model). Nearly diffuse by default so the level absorbs the user's average reward instead of it being read as a preference. Ignored when priorCovariance is given.

priorMean.description: mu0. Default: all zeros (neutral profile; only differences between dimensions matter for ranking).

priorCovariance.description: Sigma0 as a symmetric positive-definite 6x6 matrix, in Hexad dimension order. Overrides priorVariance. Hook for population priors.

noiseVariance.description: Observation noise variance of the session reward, as the model sees it. Rewards in [0,1] have variance <= 0.25 (sub-Gaussian R=1/2), but the calibration (synthetic worlds) preferred a smaller value because a too-large one makes the engine ignore the information in each session; a too-small one (0.02) made it overconfident, fitting noise as preference. To be estimated from pilot data.

samplingScale.description: v: the posterior sample is mu + v * chol(Sigma) * z. 1 = plain Thompson Sampling; the regret theory of Agrawal & Goyal needs v > 1. The default (0.15) is nearly greedy: it was chosen in the calibration because a noisy sample made the interface change a lot from session to session (churn) for little gain. It gives up the theoretical guarantee on purpose.

exposureFloor.description: Minimum output weight of any element.

neutralWeight.description: Output weight of every element under the neutral profile, before clamping.

sensitivity.description: Gain from score difference (s_e - mean s) to weight. Scores are in units of expected reward, so differences between elements are small (~0.05); a large gain is needed to use the [floor, 1] range. With the default, weights are close to a ranking (highlight vs reduce).

outcomeKinds.description: Weight of each outcome kind in the session reward. Keys are app-defined; the default app uses a single kind 'target'.

missingOutcome.description: What to do with a closed session that has no outcome event of a configured kind: treat its value as 0, or skip the session.

interactionRewardWeight.description: omega: weight of the auxiliary interaction signal in the session reward. Keep low.

seed.description: Seed of the deterministic random generator. Same seed + same events = same decisions.
